title: Baby Leo & Friends Learn About Helping Hands
summary: Today, Baby Leo and his friends explore the joy of helping others! Bella has a special idea to show how working together can solve problems. Together, they learn that giving a helping hand makes everyone feel happy.
lesson: Kids learn the importance of helping others and working as a team.
beats: Baby Leo, Bella, Bobo, Twinkle, and Marjona are playing together in the garden. They remember how sharing and being kind made them happy. Bella has an idea.
Bella says, 'Let’s help our friend, the little squirrel, find his acorns!' Everyone cheers. They love helping friends.
Baby Leo asks, 'Why does the squirrel need our help?' Bella explains that sometimes friends need a helping hand.
Bobo suggests, 'Let’s look in different places!' They split up to search for the acorns.
Marjona sings a happy song while they look. Twinkle glows bright to light the way. They feel cheerful!
Suddenly, they find a little pile of acorns! But wait, they realize it’s not enough. They need more help.
They decide to call their other animal friends for help. Together, they gather more acorns.
With everyone working together, they collect enough acorns for the squirrel. They feel proud!
When the little squirrel sees them, he jumps with joy! He thanks them for their helping hands.
The friends cheer, knowing that helping each other makes the best adventures!
